about.title: About Me
about.p1: I'm a backend developer based in <location>Palma de Mallorca</location>, currently in my second year of DAM (Cross-platform Application Development).
about.p2: I'm especially interested in building software where <highlight>data, logic, and structure</highlight> are central. I enjoy working on backend systems — APIs, database-driven applications, and data processing — approaching problems in a thoughtful and methodical way: first understanding the context, then designing the architecture, and finally writing clean, maintainable code.
about.p3: My main stack is Java and Spring Boot, where I build RESTful APIs and design database-driven applications using SQL. I've also developed full-stack applications and Android projects, which gives me a broader perspective on how backend systems integrate with real client-side environments. Recently, I've expanded my focus toward data-driven development using Python.
